test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following options are homogeneous mixtures?

options.text: Solution, colloid, suspension, milk, toothpaste, salt water, brass
Solution, colloid, milk, toothpaste, salt water, brass

solution:
The correct answer is __**Solution, salt water, brass**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Solution, colloid, suspension, milk, toothpaste, salt water, brass includes both homogeneous (solution, salt water, brass) and heterogeneous mixtures (colloid, suspension, milk, toothpaste).
 
• Solution, salt water, brass correctly identifies only homogeneous mixtures.
 
• Solution, colloid, milk, toothpaste, salt water, brass incorrectly includes colloids (milk, toothpaste) as homogeneous mixtures.
 
• Colloids are not homogeneous.Colloid, suspension, milk, toothpaste lists items that are all considered to be heterogeneous mixtures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homogeneous** Mix
